name: Historic Centre of Prague
description: Prague's historic core spreads along both banks of the Vltava River in the Czech Republic, where Gothic spires, Baroque palaces and Renaissance façades crowd together in the Old Town, Lesser Town and New Town. Most of the grandeur dates from the 14th century under Emperor Charles IV. Highlights include Prague Castle, St Vitus Cathedral, the statue-lined Charles Bridge and the astronomical clock on Old Town Square.
